com.esignal.jstandard.beans.analytics

Interface AnalyticsRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultAnalyticsRequest

    public interface AnalyticsRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to Analytics server.

    The client needs to set a unique turnaround for every request along with a request query.

    It also includes an enum value which allows defining the request format while requesting the data ANALYTICS_REQUEST_FORMAT. If the format is not defined , it defaults to JSON : ANALYTICS_REQUEST_FORMAT.JSON.

    Since:
    01-013-0000
